   The debate over Singapore Airlines’ new business-class seats misses the point
 Customers’ expectations are higher and competition from other airlines is increasing. Can Singapore Airlines still match up?
 Sign up now: Get ST's newsletters delivered to your inbox
 The new business-class seats were co-designed by SIA and Designworks, a BMW company.
 PHOTO: SINGAPORE AIRLINES
 Karen Tee 
 Published   Nov 19, 2026, 07:30 AM
 Updated   Nov 19, 2026, 04:18 PM
 Set as preferred source Unlock audio 中文 When Singapore Airlines (SIA) recently unveiled its next-generation cabins, part of a long-awaited $2 billion revamp spanning first, business, premium economy and economy classes, I did what just about everyone else did and zoomed in on pictures of the new business-class seat .
 There it was in grey leather, bisected by a yellow-green stripe that bore more than a passing resemblance to the signature colour of SIA’s budget subsidiary Scoot.
